bullets.text: Active Exploitation Alert - **Microsoft Defender** identifies ongoing attacks exploiting **SolarWinds Web Help Desk** vulnerabilities.
New Clickfix Variant - The **CrashFix** campaign uses browser crashes to deploy a **Python Remote Access Trojan**.
Microsoft 365 Community Event - Join the **Microsoft 365 Community Conference** for insights on the future of intelligent work.
Operation Winter SHIELD - A new initiative to close the **security implementation gap** in organizations.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New builds released for **Windows Insiders** in Canary and Beta Channels.
AI Security Framework - **Microsoft SDL** expands to address security concerns specific to AI development.
Enhanced Data Resiliency - **Azure NetApp Files** introduces Elastic zone-redundant service for improved data management.
Detecting Backdoored Models - New research on identifying backdoors in **language models** to enhance AI trust.
Infostealer Threats Rise - **Microsoft Defender** reports on the expansion of infostealers targeting macOS and Python environments.
